2607.02072.title: kNNGuard: Turning LLM Hidden Activations into a Training-Free Configurable Guardrail
2607.02072.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in domains requiring guardrails to detect unsafe, off-topic, or adversarial prompts. Existing guardrails predominately rely on fine-tuning to build classifiers, which often suffer from low generalization and high inference latency. We present kNNGuard, a training-free guardrail that utilizes the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM. Given a small bank of 50 safe and unsafe prompts, kNNGuard extracts hidden activations and performs multi-layer kNN fusing activation-space and embedding-space scores for classification. Across six domains spanning topical and security prompts, kNNGuard achieves competitive or superior F1 compared to fine-tuned state-of-the-art guardrails while running 2.7x faster than the best comparable guardrail, and 10x faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier without gradient updates or fine-tuning. Domain adaptation requires only updating the labeled bank, which can be constructed in under 10 seconds and several orders of magnitude faster than established guardrails. We also analyze the impact of system prompts, layer selection, and integration into production LLM pipelines as a configurable, low-latency guardrail.
2607.02072.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地應用於需要防護措施以檢測不安全、離題或對抗性提示的領域。現有的防護措施主要依賴微調來構建分類器，但這些分類器往往面臨低泛化能力和高推理延遲的問題。我們提出了 kNNGuard，一種無需訓練的防護措施，利用現成 LLM 的激活空間。給定一小組 50 個安全和不安全的提示，kNNGuard 提取隱藏的激活並執行多層 kNN 融合激活空間和嵌入空間的分數進行分類。在涵蓋主題和安全提示的六個領域中，kNNGuard 的 F1 分數與微調的最先進防護措施相比，達到了具有競爭力或更優的表現，同時運行速度比最佳可比防護措施快 2.7 倍，比沒有梯度更新或微調的微調安全分類器快 10 倍。領域適應僅需更新標記庫，該庫可在 10 秒內構建，速度比現有的防護措施快幾個數量級。我們還分析了系統提示、層選擇以及作為可配置的低延遲防護措施整合到生產 LLM 管道中的影響。
